[[File:UleiRiver.png|thumb|right|250px|Clan Shalo defeated by Clan Nutsy.]]
{{Quote|Largest river in Ivalice. Winds through swamplands.|Description}}
'''Ulei River''' {{J|ユレー川|Yurē gawa}} is a swamp location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It can be placed after "Mission #004: Desert Peril" is completed and is the site of "Mission #005: Twisted Flow", where [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] finds the first of the seams. He is then teleported to the shrine of the [[Totema]] [[Famfrit]], who guards the [[moogle]] [[Crystal (term)|crystal]], and engages Marche in battle.

After Marche defeats Famfrit, the crystal shatters, and Marche resolves to destroy the remaining crystals. Ulei River is also the site of "Mission #049: A Lost Ring", "Mission #083: Foreign Fiend", and "Mission #112: A Challenge". It can be freed in "Mission #244: Ulei River" after "Mission #008: Hot Awakening" is completed.

==Encounters==
===Clan Shalo===
{{Quote|Base located in the shallows. Avoid water engagements. Attack them on land!|Description}}
*[[Warrior (Tactics Advance)|Warrior]] (Bangaa)
*[[White Mage (Tactics Advance)|White Mage]] (Nu mou)
*[[Defender (Tactics Advance)|Defender]] (Bangaa)
*[[White Monk (Tactics Advance)|White Monk]] (Bangaa)
*[[Animist (Tactics Advance)|Animist]] (Moogle)

All members of Clan Shalo have Feather Boots equipped, allowing them to walk on the many water tiles of their home base.
